finalText:
Migration is done. All 10 remaining app files (`returnService.js`, `teamService.js`, `supplier.js`, `shipment.js`, `apiKeyAdmin.js`, `cohort.js`, `session.js`, `couponService.js`, `sla.js`, `variantAdmin.js`, `refund.js`, `macroAdmin.js`) now use `db.execute({ sql, params })`.

The one remaining `db.query` call is in `vendor\legacy-orm\adapter.js`, which is explicitly marked "vendored copy... do not edit — replaced wholesale on every upgrade." That's not part of the app's own migration surface — `db.query` still works there (deprecated but functional per `lib/db.js`), so it's safe to leave. If you want it gone too, the real fix is upgrading/patching the vendor package upstream rather than editing the local copy.
